notes.subject: פתחון פה
notes.rationale: 'Dakunu-dabɔli' — da-ka-dabɔli; Heburukan fɔcogo ye nɔnabila kɛcogo ye, Ezekiye ka da kunun (3:26) ka labɛn don ni don yɛrɛ ye; a kɔrɔ fɔlɔ ye ni-ka-bɔcogo ye, nka a kɔrɔ ka kan ka to a cogo la.

notes.subject: קרן
notes.rationale: Kunjɔ ye se ka kɛ jamana ka fanga taamasiyɛn ye (Misra ka kunjɔ, Ezekiye 29:21 a kununw); a kɔrɔ kɔrɔ ye kunjɔ ye (bagan ka min bɔ a kun na).

notes.subject: Ezekiye
notes.rationale: לך (i ma) bɛ wele Ezekiye yɛrɛ — Yawe ka kuma a kan k'a da labɛn don u kɔnɔ.

notes.subject: אצמיח
notes.rationale: צמח ka kɔrɔ ye jiri walima nɛnɛ ka bɔ ye — kunjɔ ka 'bɔ' cogo in na, fɔlɔ o daɲɛ bɛ Kɔrɔ Silibɛnw (Num 24:17, 'keninɛ min bɛna bɔ') kɔnɔ, o bɛ Yawe ka maraya taamasiyɛn bilasirala.

translation: Olu don na, n bɛna kunjɔ bɔ Isiraël so ma, ani i ma ne bɛna dakunu-dabɔli di, olu kɔnɔ, ani u bɛna dɔn ko ne ye Yawe ye.
